partners.diseaseBName: severe combined immunodeficiency due to LCK deficiency
partners.mechanism_chain: AP2S1 (HGNC:20407) —DISRUPTS→ Endosomal sorting and trafficking (GO:0005768); Endosomal sorting and trafficking (GO:0005768) —LEADS_TO→ Hypercalcemia (HP:0003113); LCK (HGNC:6555) —DISRUPTS→ T-cell receptor signaling pathway (GO:0050851); T-cell receptor signaling pathway (GO:0050851) —LEADS_TO→ Severe combined immunodeficiency (HP:0001858). Loss-of-function mutations in AP2S1 disrupt endosomal sorting and trafficking, leading to hypercalcemia. Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in LCK disrupt T-cell receptor signaling, resulting in severe combined immunodeficiency. The convergence is on the disruption of distinct cellular pathways by mutations in two distinct genes, highlighting a shared mechanism of disease module overlap.

partners.mechanism_chain: AP2S1 (HGNC:497) —DISRUPTS→ clathrin-mediated endocytosis (GO:0005887); AP2M1 (HGNC:498) —DISRUPTS→ clathrin-mediated endocytosis (GO:0005887); clathrin-mediated endocytosis (GO:0005887) —LEADS_TO→ Hypercalcemia (HP:0003128); clathrin-mediated endocytosis (GO:0005887) —LEADS_TO→ Seizures (HP:0001250); clathrin-mediated endocytosis (GO:0005887) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249). #### 1. severe combined immunodeficiency due to LCK deficiency  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.389)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-167590)

**Proposed mechanism:** AP2S1 (HGNC:20407) —DISRUPTS→ Endosomal sorting and trafficking (GO:0005768); Endosomal sorting and trafficking (GO:0005768) —LEADS_TO→ Hypercalcemia (HP:0003113); LCK (HGNC:6555) —DISRUPTS→ T-cell receptor signaling pathway (GO:0050851); T-cell receptor signaling pathway (GO:0050851) —LEADS_TO→ Severe combined immunodeficiency (HP:0001858). Loss-of-function mutations in AP2S1 disrupt endosomal sorting and trafficking, leading to hypercalcemia. Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in LCK disrupt T-cell receptor signaling, resulting in severe combined immunodeficiency. The convergence is on the disruption of distinct cellular pathways by mutations in two distinct genes, highlighting a shared mechanism of disease module overlap.

**How to falsify it:** The absence of any shared downstream pathway or molecular interaction between the AP2S1-mediated endosomal trafficking pathway and the LCK-mediated T-cell receptor signaling pathway would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: rs75009383 (AP2S1))_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the distinct yet potentially overlapping cellular dysfunctions caused by mutations in AP2S1 and LCK could inform the development of targeted therapies for each disease, and potentially reveal shared therapeutic strategies for diseases impacting cellular trafficking and immune signaling.
